name: Kangaroo Island
summary: Kangaroo Island is a large, wild island off South Australia, full of animals. See sea lions on the beach at Seal Bay, kangaroos and koalas in the bush, the wind-sculpted Remarkable Rocks and Admirals Arch with its fur seals, and taste local honey, gin and oysters.
seasonNote: Spring to autumn; winter is cool and windy.
arrival: Ferry from Cape Jervis (45 minutes; 2 hours' drive from Adelaide) or a 30-minute flight.
gettingAround: A car is essential; distances are big.
cashTip: Cards and tap-to-pay work almost everywhere; tipping isn't expected.
foodTip: Oysters, marron, Ligurian bee honey and local gin.

connections.note: Drive to Cape Jervis, then the SeaLink ferry.
